Warm & Comfortable: Crafted from a pill-resistant cotton / polyester fabric blend that is breathable and soft to the touch, the printed hoodie provides all-day comfort and warmth, especially in the spring, fall, and winter. The USMC sweatshirt features a double-layer string hood. Utility at the Forefront: The graphic hooded sweatshirt features a front kangaroo pocket for additional storage and warming your hands. Show Your American Spirit: This hoodie is an officially licensed product of the United States Marine Corps. In addition to being a great mid layer for outdoor exercise routines, a day at the range, or daily use, these sweatshirts are perfect for active-duty personnel, veterans, and more. We’ve Got You Covered: Pair your rugged hoodie with one of our Tactical BDU Cargo Pants or Vintage Paratrooper Cargo Fatigue Pants.
